text:
I can't say whether the property is legally compliant. The tool explicitly does not establish any regulatory or compliance finding, such as EUDR compliant, non-compliant or deforestation-free.

What the evidence does show for ASSET-B (2,843.1 ha), for 2021–2025:
- No tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected after the 2020-12-31 baseline. Valid data covered 100% of the asset.
- Only 0.4 ha of loss in sub-0.5 ha patches was seen, in 2021. It is not counted as an event.
- JRC maps 0 ha of forest in 2020.
- Earlier loss occurred before the baseline (2008, 2015, 2017, 2020, including 67.7 ha in 2020). It falls outside the claim period.

Limits: changes under 0.5 ha, at edges, or narrower than the 30 m pixels may be missed. The results say nothing about periods outside 2021–2025. Also, the MGAP 2021 source was unavailable.

A compliance judgment would need legal analysis beyond this satellite evidence.
